g.title: r10

g.title: note
g.text: Scope: Linux tag v6.6; ordinary established IPv4 TCP, physical NIC, local delivery.
Grouped arrows are selected call/continuation paths, not an exhaustive dynamic call trace.
Native vs generic XDP are alternatives. GRO may use batched list variants.
DROP/QUEUE/REDIRECT can stop or divert any path. Hook presence depends on config/attachments.
Excluded: bridge/veth/tunnel/IPsec/IPv6/hardware offload, full handshake & error state machines.
FORWARD is not traversed by local TCP; see overview for all five chains and four tables.
Netfilter BPF (since 6.4) may attach inside orange hooks at its configured priority.
